title: Hosted API geo commitment chronicle and region pinflow
creator: Amelia Park
description: Build a tenant-facing orchestration for Hosted API region pinning that (1) records declarative geo commitments in an append-only chronicle, (2) enforces retention policies for residency-related metadata, and (3) automatically composes signed evidence bundles for audits. The feature must be usable from the Console and API, integrate with routing/fallback policies, and generate machine-readable proof artifacts for compliance and customer attestations.
background: Customers in regulated industries ask for both operator-enforced region pins and machine-verifiable evidence that their data routes and storage matched tenant residency commitments. Existing pin UI/controls are ad hoc and do not produce a tamper-evident export. This initiative standardizes the lifecycle: pin declaration -> routing enforcement -> retention enforcement -> evidence harvest -> signed export.
goals: Provide Console + API primitives to declare tenant geo commitment with TTL and soft/hard mode
Create an append-only chronicle per tenant that records pin events, overrides, and automated routing decisions
Implement a citable evidence bundle format (JSONL + manifest + signatures) for audits
Wireup routing checks to prefer pinned regions and fallback to compatible variants with documented rationale
Enforce retention windows for residency metadata and include retention proof in exports
Expose telemetry: pin-coverage %, routing deviations, evidence-export frequency and size
acceptance_criteria: Console: Create/Edit pin with mode (soft|hard), primary region list, TTL and reason field
API: /tenants/{id}/residency-pin GET/POST/DELETE with RFC-like schema and ETag semantics
Chronicle: append-only log stored for configurable retention and included in evidence exports
Evidence bundle: contains manifest.json, chronicle.jsonl, routing-traces.jsonl, retention-proofs.json, signed with KMS key and downloadable from Console/API
Routing: requests for pinned tenants are routed to pinned region nodes unless capacity SLO would be violated; fallback decision logged in chronicle
E2E tests: integration test that simulates cluster failover and demonstrates evidence shows fallback and timestamps
Security review: sign-off on KMS usage, ACLs for evidence downloads, and tamper-evidence controls
tasks: Spec: finalize chronicle schema, evidence bundle manifest and signature format (contrib: legal/compliance)
Console: pin workflow UI + audit trail view and download button
API: pin endpoints, validation, and ETag conflict semantics
Routing: integrate pin-check in smart-routing layer with telemetry hooks
Retention: implement TTL enforcement job and retention-proof generation
Evidence: composer service to assemble manifest, sign via KMS, and store bundle in evidence-store
Docs: Confluence runbook for auditors and API reference
Tests: unit, integration, and chaos tests for fallback scenarios
updates: 2026-03-02: Kickoff with legal and infra; legal prefers SHA-256 manifest and a retention-proof per export.
2026-03-05: Engine design review — routing will check pin set before model variant selection; agreed to emit 'pin_ranking' telemetry to evaluate SLO impact.
2026-03-08: Security SR requested for KMS signing key partitioning and RBAC for evidence downloads (ticket SEC-1294).
2026-03-11: UX mock approved with two-step pin dialog (reason required) and clear soft vs hard descriptions; added 'backup region list' field.
2026-03-14: PoC evidence composer implemented in staging; signed bundle produced and manually verified by compliance team. Next: automated scheduled exports and retention job.
Review feedback: Engineering asked to limit chronicle retention for cost controls; PM proposed configurable retention per org with a compliance minimum
comments: Jia (Engineering): We need to quantify additional token-level routing latencies; batching windows may be affected when honoring hard pins.
Sam (Compliance): Evidence bundles must include a canonical timezone and server clock reference for auditors.
Priya (Solutions): Add a migration path for tenants who previously used region preference to the new pin model.
QA note: Create synthetic tenant that toggles pin mode during heavy traffic to verify chronicle integrity
risks: Hard pins may increase request latency or reduce available capacity in certain regions leading to customer SLO violations
Large chronicle retention for many tenants increases storage cost and export time
Evidence signing requires careful KMS policy to avoid accidental exposure
Automated exports could leak PII if retention-proofs include unredacted routing traces — must sanitize
mitigations: Implement soft mode and require explicit opt-in for hard mode with warning and SLA tradeoff
Retention tiering: default short retention, compliance tier for longer retention at cost
KMS keys scoped to compliance service with strict IAM and audit logs
Sanitization rules for traces: replace IPs with hashed identifiers and include schema in manifest
next_steps: ENG: Finalize chronicle schema and push PR for API endpoints (target 2026-03-21)
SEC: provide KMS key policy and sign-off (target 2026-03-18)
PM: prepare customer comms and migration guide for tenants using legacy preferences
Design: polish Console export UX and add verification UI for evidence bundles
